utah_rule.grade_scope: elementary DLI programme; entry grade not inferred
utah_rule.user_instruction: I think we can safely label all Utah elementary schools as 50-50 programs.
utah_rule.source_quote: All state-sponsored schools with Dual Language Immersion programs are required to implement the fifty-fifty model
utah_rule.limitations: Statewide model assignment, not an observed campus timetable, exact entering-cohort allocation or confirmation of 2025-26 operation. Secondary-only and unresolved-grade campuses do not inherit elementary models.
